shortDesc.zh: 基于Nunjucks静态构建的学术博客，支持Markdown渲染与双语切换
shortDesc.en: Static academic blog built with Nunjucks, Markdown rendering & bilingual support

description.zh: 个人学术博客网站，使用 Node.js + Nunjucks 模板引擎静态构建。内容以 Markdown 编写，构建时渲染为 HTML 并部署到 GitHub Pages。支持课程笔记管理、项目展示、博客文章与暗色模式。
description.en: Personal academic blog built with Node.js + Nunjucks static site generator. Content written in Markdown, rendered to HTML at build time, deployed to GitHub Pages. Features course notes, project showcase, blog posts, and dark mode.

shortDesc.zh: 基于PyTorch的图像分类实验项目
shortDesc.en: Image classification lab project based on PyTorch

description.zh: 使用PyTorch实现多种图像分类模型（ResNet、ViT等），在CIFAR-100和自定义数据集上进行训练和评估，对比不同模型架构的性能。
description.en: Implementing various image classification models (ResNet, ViT, etc.) with PyTorch, training and evaluating on CIFAR-100 and custom datasets, comparing performance across architectures.
